reason: Verifies SHA-256-pinned, sanitized Windows readiness observations against explicit requirements and produces deterministic reports without collecting host data or applying remediation.

summaries.zh: 该插件根据明确的就绪要求验证预先收集且经过脱敏的 Windows 证据，并生成确定性的检查报告。
summaries.en: This plugin verifies pre-collected, sanitized Windows readiness evidence against explicit requirements and produces deterministic verification reports.

capabilities: Inspects supplied readiness manifests and evidence artifacts
Verifies pre-collected Windows readiness evidence against explicit requirements
Produces deterministic verification reports and exit statuses
Exposes CLI, DSH, and MCP inspection and verification tools
